updates.notes: Distinct product fork imports PiliPlus OH layer: final EntryAbility, HarmonyChannel and native Index are byte-identical to registered snapshot, not independent native corroboration. Later in-app PiP fix adds separate desired-render-state exclusion, notifies queue after changing overlay state on entry/exit, adds custom renderer platform-controller notifier branch, and changes dependency resolved video ref. Earlier comments/transparent-backdrop mechanism assumed underlay composition; later source explicitly revises comment to HCPP overlay composition and removes backdrop machinery. Consumer now requires actual composition-mode verification and conditional transparency rather than asserting universal layer order. Native media-kit fork/engine internals were not separately inspected, so neither stacking comment nor PiP black-screen fix is runtime proof. System and in-app PiP are separate host policies; fallback limitations scoped to selected renderer.

Consumer describes conditional controls and acceptance checks without adopting numeric defaults, decoder/conversion guarantees or SDR omission semantics universally. PiliNara later corrects in-app PiP: same Flutter-view overlay keeps HDR, only native/system PiP forces selected texture/SDR fallback; supersedes prior blanket in-app fallback source. Dependency lock updates claim theme/HDR surface fix but native fork internals and compositor output unverified. Same-subject fork changes have different patch IDs except explicitly recorded copies.
